summary.text: Victor Dominquez is the Democratic candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a member of the Oglala Sioux Tribe.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Dominquez listed three key campaign messages: strengthening relations between the state and its tribes, extending healthcare and childcare programs to ease the financial burden on South Dakotans, and protecting the Black Hills from industry.

He named housing affordability, public infrastructure, environmental protection of the Black Hills, water supply and quality, and a healthcare and childcare gap among the state's greatest challenges over the next decade.
He said that he looks up to his mother, who he said sacrificed her own ambitions so that he and his nine siblings could have a better life.
